title: Hinomori Shizuku — Determined Brilliance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright... Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We've finished passing out the drinks and snacks, so we should be able to begin whenever.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, here's to Shizuku's hard work and the shoot for her commercial going so well♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Take it away for us, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, then...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Saito
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: These Japanese sweets are for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
These little birds made out of white bean paste and sugar are just so adorable.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
They really are!
Where did you find these?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
At the mall.
This shop just happened to have a pop-up stall there when we went over to shop for this party.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We need to thank our lucky stars for coming across these yummy and adorable treats!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So...
Here's a panda manju for you, Saito!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
You got this just for me...
I promise to save it until just before it expires!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were hoping that you'd eat it today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: <Make your eyes more radiant.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Look, her Gran Fleur commercial's playing on the TV!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No matter how many times I watch it, I still can't believe how beautiful she looks...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I know, right...?!
I actually watched it over and over in order to build up some resistance, but I just kept falling further and further in love with her...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Especially when they go in for her close-up. I'm still too afraid to look directly at her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly. It always takes a really long time to settle your mind after your favorite idol shines so blindingly bright!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also kept watching it on loop in order to be able to take in Shizuku's overwhelming beauty in its full form...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's so kind of you two.
You really watched my commercial that many times?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Geez... If these two keep watching it on loop, then they're gonna end up becoming responsible for a huge percentage of the video views.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of that site...
The day that commercial was uploaded, it immediately found its way into the trend rankings!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, a lot of our fans also said they watched it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, it's reached an enormous number of views, and the comments section is buzzing too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: #Shizuku even started trending on the other social media platforms! I was actually so surprised that I almost dropped my phone!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
The response she got really was unbelievable...!
Plus, a lot of people seem to have learned about MORE MORE JUMP! for the first time through her commercial.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It's hard to say if there's a direct correlation, but the streams that have been archived have also been getting more views.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A huge success in every way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad that I was able to make such a major contribution.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for all your hard work, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was actually a little worried, since we placed such high expectations on you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We jumped to how this could lead to more work for us, which was only made worse by the fact that the offer was directed only at you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you ended up working super duper hard for our sake...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you won a spot to appear on that commercial.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only did you have a successful shoot, you even managed to get everyone to start talking about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As this group's producer, I can confidently say that you really saved us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, allow me to thank you again for your efforts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I need to thank all of you as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I must have made you all worry by expressing doubt and not showing more backbone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that's totally normal!
My heart probably would've exploded if I were placed in the same situation.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mine too. This commercial was never going to be an easy job, regardless of who was chosen to appear in it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you passed this test with flying colors, Shizuku. You lived up to our lofty expectations and achieved a tremendous result.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, instead of feeling bad, you should be feeling proud!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. The fact that you were all willing to believe in me during this crucial period...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That filled me with so much happiness. That's what gave me the strength to see this challenge through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course, I'm happy that I was able to do well during the shoot, and about how well received the commercial has been...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But most of all, I'm proud of the fact that I was able to help our group during our time of need.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Then, I'm glad you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's keep eating, shall we?
There are still plenty of Japanese sweets left.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you're free to have as much as you like, because you're the star of today's show, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
But you bought so many different kinds that I don't know where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, then... How about these manju?
I think they're made using tofu skin, and they look very good!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As for me, I have some special yokan for you♪ It's designed to look like the night sky, and has this beautiful color gradation to it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
How about some of these dango?
The red bean paste has bits of real peach in it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You have your share of picks.
Why not take this opportunity to try all of them? This is also my cheat day, so I'll help you finish them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you! Then, I'll get started on these now.
